reason: Correct one over-strong ordering assertion exposed by the rejected v1 run while preserving every case and every numerical output field.

relation_changes.justification: Active inputs are a mathematical set. Each position has a deterministic enumeration order, but rank reflection reverses board-square traversal and pocket ownership changes pocket traversal order. The transformer sums the same unique indices and does not require cross-position sequence equality.

stopping_rule: The fresh run must use the exact v1 base plus this exact overlay in a new output namespace. It must restart every UCI/load/negative/two-run/case/relation check. No lease-117 output may be copied into the admitted golden.
